answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 100-coin deposit, twice its monthly reward. Each epoch a beacon samples 5%; each must answer a compute heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving live work behind its sable-dark filing. An ivory key signs the heartbeat, and the crystal-clear log lets anyone verify it. A miss burns the deposit: 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 coins. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
